objectives.en: I can tell countable and uncountable nouns apart, including information, advice, money, furniture and news.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להבחין בין שמות עצם ספירים ושאינם ספירים, כולל information, advice, money, furniture ו-news.

objectives.en: I can use much, many, a lot of, a few and a little correctly.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת להשתמש נכון ב-much, many, a lot of, a few ו-a little.

objectives.en: I can ask about quantities with How much ...? and How many ...?
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת לשאול על כמויות בעזרת How much ...? ו-How many ...?

warmup.en: How many hours do you sleep? How much time do you spend on your phone? Why many with hours, but much with time? Today you'll find out.
warmup.he: כמה שעות אתם ישנים? כמה זמן אתם מבלים בטלפון? בעברית זו אותה מילה – 'כמה'. באנגלית אומרים How many hours אבל How much time. היום נבין למה.

explanation.en: I have three apples and some bread (not *three breads). Apple is countable: one apple, two apples. Bread is uncountable: it has no plural and no a/an. Many words work like bread: water, money, time, music, homework.
explanation.he: I have three apples and some bread (ולא three breads). המילה apple היא שם עצם ספיר: one apple, two apples. המילה bread אינה ספירה: אין לה רבים ואין לפניה a/an. מילים רבות מתנהגות כמו bread: water, money, time, music, homework.

explanation.en: In positive sentences, use a lot of: I drink a lot of water (not *I drink much water). Much and many are most common in questions and negatives: Do you have much homework? There aren't many people here. Remember from A1: some and any also work with both kinds, some in positive sentences and any in questions and negatives (Is there any milk?).
explanation.he: במשפט חיובי משתמשים ב-a lot of: I drink a lot of water (ולא I drink much water). המילים much ו-many נפוצות בעיקר בשאלות ובשלילה: Do you have much homework? There aren't many people here. וכזכור מרמה A1: גם some ו-any מתאימים לשני הסוגים – some במשפט חיובי, ו-any בשאלה ובשלילה (Is there any milk?).

explanation.en: These nouns are uncountable in English: information, advice, news, furniture, homework, luggage. No -s and no a/an: some information (not *informations), some advice (not *an advice). News takes is: The news is good.
explanation.he: שמות העצם האלה אינם ספירים באנגלית: information, advice, news, furniture, homework, luggage. אין להם s ואין לפניהם a/an: some information ולא informations, וגם some advice ולא an advice. אחרי news בא is: The news is good.

explanation.en: To count an uncountable noun, use a word like piece, bottle or cup: a piece of advice, two pieces of furniture, a bottle of water, a cup of coffee.
explanation.he: כדי לספור שם עצם שאינו ספיר משתמשים במילה כמו piece, bottle או cup: a piece of advice, two pieces of furniture, a bottle of water, a cup of coffee.

examples.en: How many people are coming tonight?
How much money do you need?
We've got a lot of homework this week.
examples.he: יש לנו הרבה שיעורי בית השבוע.
examples.note: a lot of: positive, both kinds

examples.en: I don't have much time right now.
There aren't many shops in our street.
Can I ask you a few questions?
Can you give me some advice?
We need two pieces of furniture: a desk and a chair.
examples.he: אנחנו צריכים שני רהיטים: שולחן כתיבה וכיסא.

vocab.example: Can I get some information about the course?

vocab.def: an opinion about what someone should do
vocab.example: My brother gave me some good advice.

vocab.def: new information about something that has happened
things like chairs, tables, beds and cupboards
vocab.example: We need some furniture for the new flat.

vocab.def: the bags and cases you take when you travel
vocab.example: How much luggage can I take on the plane?

vocab.def: work a teacher gives you to do at home
vocab.example: We have a lot of homework this weekend.

vocab.def: coins and notes that you use to buy things
vocab.example: I don't have much money this month.

vocab.def: the cars, buses and other vehicles on the roads
vocab.example: There isn't much traffic on Friday afternoon.

vocab.def: money in coins and notes, not on a card
vocab.example: Do you have any cash? The kiosk doesn't take cards.

vocab.def: one item or part of something uncountable
vocab.example: Can I give you a piece of advice?

vocab.def: a small number of (with plural countable nouns)
vocab.example: I'll be there in a few minutes.

vocab.def: a small amount of (with uncountable nouns)
vocab.example: Can I have a little milk in my coffee?

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew a question with 'how much' or 'how many' needs no helper verb, so it is easy to say *How much money you have? English needs do or does after the noun: How much money do you have? How many brothers does she have?
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית שאלה עם 'כמה' לא צריכה פועל עזר ('כמה כסף יש לך?'), ולכן קל לומר How much money you have?. באנגלית צריך do או does אחרי שם העצם: How much money do you have? How many brothers does she have?

hebrew_pitfalls.en: Hebrew has no /ʌ/ vowel, so money /ˈmʌni/ often comes out as 'mani'. many is spelled with a, so it can come out as 'mani' too, and then the two words sound the same. many has /e/, as in pen; money has the short, relaxed /ʌ/, as in cup.
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית אין את התנועה /ʌ/, ולכן money /ˈmʌni/ יוצא לעיתים קרובות 'מָאנִי'. גם many, שנכתב עם a, יוצא לפעמים 'מָאנִי', ואז שתי המילים נשמעות אותו דבר. ב-many יש /e/ כמו ב-pen ('מֶנִי'), וב-money יש /ʌ/ קצרה ורפויה, כמו ב-cup.

prompt.en: Countable or uncountable? Sort the words.
prompt.he: ספיר או לא ספיר? מיינו את המילים.

hint.en: Can you put a number before it (two chairs)? Then it's countable.
hint.he: אפשר לשים לפניו מספר (two chairs)? אם כן, הוא ספיר.

explanation.en: The words come in pairs with similar meanings: a chair / furniture, a suitcase / luggage, a coin / money, an idea / advice, a message / news. The first in each pair is countable; the second is not.
explanation.he: המילים באות בזוגות עם משמעות דומה: a chair / furniture, a suitcase / luggage, a coin / money, an idea / advice, a message / news. המילה הראשונה בכל זוג ספירה, והשנייה לא.

exercises.question: How ___ people are coming to the party?

0.en: people is a countable plural, so use How many.
0.he: people הוא שם עצם ספיר ברבים, ולכן How many.

2.en: We don't say How a lot. For questions, use How many.
2.he: לא אומרים How a lot. בשאלה משתמשים ב-How many.

3.en: a little goes with uncountable nouns (a little time), and it doesn't come after How.
3.he: a little בא עם שמות עצם שאינם ספירים (a little time), והוא לא בא אחרי How.

explanation.en: How many + plural countable noun: How many people? How much + uncountable noun: How much time?
explanation.he: How many + שם עצם ספיר ברבים: How many people? ו-How much + שם עצם שאינו ספיר: How much time?

exercises.audio_text: Hurry up! We haven't got much time. Just take a few things – the car is really small.
exercises.question: What does the speaker say?
options: They have a lot of time.
They should take a lot of things.
They should take only a few things.

0.en: Listen again: 'We haven't got much time.'
0.he: הקשיבו שוב: We haven't got much time – אין להם הרבה זמן.

1.en: The speaker says the car is really small.

2.en: 'Just take a few things' – not a lot.
2.he: 'Just take a few things' – רק כמה דברים, לא הרבה.

explanation.en: not much time (uncountable) · a few things (countable plural). Both describe a small quantity.
explanation.he: not much time (לא ספיר) · a few things (ספיר ברבים). שניהם מתארים כמות קטנה.

exercises.question: I drink ___ water when it's hot.

0.en: In positive sentences, much sounds unnatural. Use a lot of: I drink a lot of water.
0.he: במשפט חיובי much נשמע לא טבעי. משתמשים ב-a lot of: I drink a lot of water.

1.en: water is uncountable, so not many.
1.he: water אינו ספיר, ולכן לא many.

2.en: a few goes with countable plurals (a few bottles). water is uncountable.
2.he: a few בא עם שמות עצם ספירים ברבים (a few bottles), ו-water אינו ספיר.

explanation.en: a lot of works with both kinds of noun, and it's the natural choice in positive sentences.
explanation.he: a lot of מתאים לשני סוגי שמות העצם, והוא הבחירה הטבעית במשפט חיובי.

prompt.en: Complete with much, many, a few or a little. Use each one once.
prompt.he: השלימו ב-much, many, a few או a little. השתמשו בכל אחת פעם אחת.

exercises.text: How ___ students are in your class? How ___ homework do you get? I'll be ready in ___ minutes. Can I have ___ milk in my coffee, please?
answers: many
much
a few
a little

feedback.en: much goes with uncountable nouns (much homework, much time), not with plurals like students or minutes.
feedback.he: much בא עם שמות עצם שאינם ספירים (much homework, much time), ולא עם רבים כמו students או minutes.

feedback.en: many goes with countable plurals (many students). homework and milk are uncountable.
feedback.he: many בא עם שמות עצם ספירים ברבים (many students), ואילו homework ו-milk אינם ספירים.

feedback.en: a few goes with countable plurals (in a few minutes), and it never comes after How. homework and milk are uncountable.
feedback.he: a few בא עם ספירים ברבים (in a few minutes), והוא אף פעם לא בא אחרי How. המילים homework ו-milk אינן ספירות.

feedback.en: a little goes with uncountable nouns (a little milk), and it never comes after How. students and minutes are countable.
feedback.he: a little בא עם שמות עצם שאינם ספירים (a little milk), והוא אף פעם לא בא אחרי How. המילים students ו-minutes ספירות.

explanation.en: students, minutes → many / a few (countable). homework, milk → much / a little (uncountable).
explanation.he: students, minutes → many / a few (ספירים). homework, milk → much / a little (לא ספירים).

exercises.question: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge. I'll buy some on my way home.

0.en: This sentence is negative (isn't), so use any. some is for positive sentences: I'll buy some.
0.he: המשפט שלילי (isn't), ולכן any. את some משתמשים במשפט חיובי: I'll buy some.

1.en: milk is uncountable, so not many. In a negative, use any (or much).
1.he: milk אינו ספיר, ולכן לא many. במשפט שלילי: any (או much).

2.en: a few goes with countable plurals (a few eggs). milk is uncountable.
2.he: a few בא עם ספירים ברבים (a few eggs), ו-milk אינו ספיר.

explanation.en: some and any work with both kinds of noun. Use any in negatives and questions (There isn't any milk. Is there any bread?) and some in positive sentences (I'll buy some).
explanation.he: some ו-any מתאימים לשני סוגי שמות העצם. any בא בשלילה ובשאלה (There isn't any milk. Is there any bread?), ו-some במשפט חיובי (I'll buy some).

prompt.en: Complete with piece, bottle or cup.

exercises.text: Can I give you a ___ of advice? I always carry a ___ of water in my bag. Would you like a ___ of coffee?
answers: piece
bottle
cup

feedback.en: cup is for hot drinks: a cup of coffee or tea.
feedback.he: cup משמש למשקאות חמים: a cup of coffee או a cup of tea.

feedback.en: bottle is for drinks you can carry: a bottle of water.
feedback.he: bottle משמש למשקה שאפשר לשאת איתך: a bottle of water.

feedback.en: piece counts things like advice, furniture or cake: a piece of advice.
feedback.he: piece משמש לספירת דברים כמו advice, furniture או cake: a piece of advice.

explanation.en: a piece of advice · a bottle of water · a cup of coffee. These words let you count uncountable nouns.
explanation.he: a piece of advice · a bottle of water · a cup of coffee. המילים האלה מאפשרות לספור שמות עצם שאינם ספירים.

prompt.en: Write a question for this answer. Start with How much or How many.
prompt.he: כתבו שאלה שמתאימה לתשובה. התחילו ב-How much או ב-How many.

answers: How much money do you have?
How much money have you got?
How many shekels do you have?
How many shekels have you got?
How much do you have?

feedback.en: An English question needs do: How much money do you have?
feedback.he: בשאלה באנגלית צריך do: How much money do you have?

wrong_feedback.match: How many money do you have?

feedback.en: money is uncountable: How much money. (Shekels are countable: How many shekels.)
feedback.he: money אינו ספיר: How much money. (שקלים הם ספירים: How many shekels.)

wrong_feedback.match: How much shekels do you have?

feedback.en: shekels is a countable plural: How many shekels. (Or: How much money.)
feedback.he: shekels הוא ספיר ברבים: How many shekels. (או: How much money.)

feedback.en: You need do: How many shekels do you have?
feedback.he: חסר do: How many shekels do you have?

wrong_feedback.match: How much money does you have?

feedback.en: With you, use do: How much money do you have?
feedback.he: עם you משתמשים ב-do: How much money do you have?

hint.en: Ask about money (uncountable) or about shekels (countable).
hint.he: אפשר לשאול על money (לא ספיר) או על shekels (ספיר).

explanation.en: money → How much money ...? shekels → How many shekels ...? Both questions need do + you + have.
explanation.he: money → How much money ...? ו-shekels → How many shekels ...? בשתי השאלות צריך do + you + have.

exercises.sentence: Can you give me an advice?
answers: Can you give me some advice?
Can you give me a piece of advice?
Can you give me advice?
Can you give me a bit of advice?
Can you give me a little advice?

explanation.en: advice has no a/an and no plural. Say some advice or a piece of advice.
explanation.he: ל-advice אין a/an ואין רבים. אומרים some advice או a piece of advice.

exercises.sentence: The news are really good today.
answers: The news is really good today.

hint.en: news looks plural, but it isn't.
hint.he: news נראה כמו רבים, אבל הוא לא.

explanation.en: news is uncountable, so it takes a singular verb: The news is really good today.
explanation.he: news אינו ספיר, ולכן הפועל שאחריו ביחיד: The news is really good today.

prompt.en: Put the words in order to make a question.

explanation.en: How much + uncountable noun + can + I + verb: How much luggage can I take?
explanation.he: How much + שם עצם שאינו ספיר + can + I + פועל: How much luggage can I take?

prompt.en: Read the notice for volunteers and answer the questions.
prompt.he: קראו את ההודעה למתנדבים וענו על השאלות.

exercises.title: Volunteer week at Green Valley Farm: what to bring
exercises.passage:
Thanks for joining our volunteer week! Here is some important information before you arrive.
Luggage: There isn't much space in the rooms, so please bring only one bag. You don't need a lot of clothes – there's a washing machine.
Money: There are no shops near the farm. Bring a little cash for the weekend trip. You don't need much: the bus and lunch cost about 60 shekels.
Food: We cook a lot of vegetables from the farm. There isn't any meat, but there's a lot of cheese and fresh bread.
Free time: We have a few bikes and some board games. The Wi-Fi is slow, so don't plan to watch many films!
Any questions? Just email us – we're always happy to give advice.
Dana, Volunteer Coordinator

questions.statement: Volunteers should bring a lot of clothes.

explanation.en: 'You don't need a lot of clothes – there's a washing machine.'
explanation.he: בהודעה: You don't need a lot of clothes – יש מכונת כביסה, ולכן לא צריך הרבה בגדים.

questions.question: Why do volunteers need a little cash?

1.en: The notice doesn't say the washing machine costs money.
1.he: בהודעה לא כתוב שמכונת הכביסה עולה כסף.

2.en: The notice says the Wi-Fi is slow, not that it costs money.
2.he: בהודעה כתוב שהאינטרנט איטי, לא שהוא עולה כסף.

explanation.en: 'Bring a little cash for the weekend trip.'
explanation.he: בהודעה: Bring a little cash for the weekend trip – קצת מזומן לטיול של סוף השבוע.

questions.question: Which is true about the food?
options: There is a lot of meat.
There are a lot of vegetables from the farm.

0.he: בהודעה: There isn't any meat – אין בשר בכלל.

1.he: יש הרבה גבינה: there's a lot of cheese.

explanation.en: 'We cook a lot of vegetables from the farm.'
explanation.he: בהודעה: We cook a lot of vegetables from the farm – מבשלים הרבה ירקות מהחווה.

questions.statement: The farm has a lot of bikes.

explanation.en: 'We have a few bikes' – a small number, not a lot.
explanation.he: בהודעה: We have a few bikes – כמה אופניים, מספר קטן, לא הרבה.

questions.text: There isn't ___ space in the rooms, so bring only one bag.
answers: much
a lot of
lots of

explanation.en: 'There isn't much space in the rooms.' space is uncountable, so use much (or a lot of).
explanation.he: בהודעה: There isn't much space in the rooms. המילה space אינה ספירה, ולכן much (או a lot of).

exercises.source: כמה כסף יש לך? יש לי רק כמה שקלים.
answers: How much money do you have? I only have a few shekels.
How much money do you have? I have only a few shekels.
How much money do you have? I've only got a few shekels.
How much money do you have? I just have a few shekels.
How much money do you have? I have just a few shekels.
How much money have you got? I only have a few shekels.
How much money have you got? I have only a few shekels.
How much money have you got? I've only got a few shekels.
How much money do you have? Only a few shekels.
How much money have you got? Only a few shekels.

wrong_feedback.match: How much money you have? I only have a few shekels.

feedback.en: The question needs do: How much money do you have?
feedback.he: בעברית אין כאן פועל עזר, אבל באנגלית השאלה צריכה do: How much money do you have?

wrong_feedback.match: How many money do you have? I only have a few shekels.

feedback.en: money is uncountable: How much money.
feedback.he: money אינו ספיר: How much money.

feedback.en: money is uncountable, so How much money (not How many).
feedback.he: money אינו ספיר, ולכן How much money ולא How many.

feedback.en: shekels are countable, so a few shekels. a little is for uncountable nouns (a little money).
feedback.he: שקלים הם ספירים, ולכן a few shekels. את a little משתמשים עם שמות עצם שאינם ספירים (a little money).

feedback.en: With only, say a few: I only have a few shekels.
feedback.he: כאן 'כמה' פירושו 'מעט', ועם only אומרים a few: I only have a few shekels.

hint.en: One Hebrew word appears twice, but it becomes two different English phrases: How much and a few.
hint.he: המילה 'כמה' מופיעה פעמיים, אבל באנגלית היא מתורגמת אחרת בכל פעם: How much (שאלה על כסף) ו-a few (מספר קטן של שקלים).

explanation.en: How much money (uncountable) do you have? – I only have a few shekels (countable plural).
explanation.he: 'כמה' בשאלה על כסף = How much (כסף אינו ספיר), ו'כמה שקלים' במובן 'מעט שקלים' = a few shekels. ובשאלה צריך do: How much money do you have?

exercises.audio_text: There isn't much traffic today, so we'll be there in a few minutes.
answers: There isn't much traffic today, so we'll be there in a few minutes.

hint.en: Listen for much and a few.

explanation.en: much traffic (uncountable) · a few minutes (countable).
explanation.he: much traffic (לא ספיר) · a few minutes (ספיר).

exercises.target: How many people are coming, and how much money do we need?

focus.en: many /ˈmeni/ has the vowel of pen; money /ˈmʌni/ has the short vowel of cup. Make the difference clear.
focus.he: ב-many /ˈmeni/ יש את התנועה של pen, וב-money /ˈmʌni/ יש את התנועה הקצרה של cup. הקפידו על ההבדל.

explanation.en: When you plan a party or a trip, you often need both questions.
explanation.he: כשמתכננים מסיבה או טיול, צריך בדרך כלל את שתי השאלות.

prompt.en: Mediation: pass on a message in English.

task.en: Daniel, a friend from London, is coming to stay with your family next week. Your mum sent you a message in Hebrew (you can see it in the Hebrew instructions). Write Daniel a message in English (40-80 words) with all her information.
task.he: דניאל, חבר מלונדון, מגיע לגור אצל המשפחה שלכם בשבוע הבא. אמא שלכם שלחה לכם את ההודעה הזאת: „תגידו לדניאל שאין הרבה מקום בארון, אז שיביא רק מזוודה אחת. הוא לא צריך הרבה מזומן – כמעט בכל מקום אפשר לשלם בכרטיס. ושיביא כמה סוודרים, כי בירושלים קר בלילה. אם יש לו שאלות, שישלח לי הודעה.” כתבו לדניאל הודעה באנגלית (40-80 מילים) עם כל המידע.

exercises.model_answer: Hi Daniel! My mum asked me to send you some information. There isn't much space in the wardrobe, so please bring only one suitcase. You don't need much cash – you can pay by card almost everywhere. But bring a few jumpers, because it's cold in Jerusalem at night. If you have any questions, you can send her a message. See you next week!

checklist.en: I passed on all the information: space, one suitcase, cash, jumpers, questions.
checklist.he: העברתי את כל המידע: מקום בארון, מזוודה אחת, מזומן, סוודרים ושאלות.

checklist.en: I used much with uncountable nouns (much space, much cash) and a few with plurals (a few jumpers).
checklist.he: השתמשתי ב-much עם שמות עצם שאינם ספירים (much space, much cash) וב-a few עם רבים (a few jumpers).

checklist.en: I didn't add -s or a/an to uncountable nouns (information, money, luggage).
checklist.he: לא הוספתי s או a/an לשמות עצם שאינם ספירים (information, money, luggage).

checklist.en: I wrote natural English for Daniel, not a word-for-word translation.
checklist.he: כתבתי אנגלית טבעית לדניאל, לא תרגום מילה במילה.

key_points.en: Countable nouns have a plural (two friends); uncountable nouns don't (money, time, information).
key_points.he: לשמות עצם ספירים יש רבים (two friends); לשמות עצם שאינם ספירים אין (money, time, information).

key_points.en: information, advice, news, furniture, homework, luggage: no -s, no a/an. The news is good.
key_points.he: information, advice, news, furniture, homework, luggage: בלי s ובלי a/an. וגם: The news is good.

key_points.en: How many + plural (How many people?) · How much + uncountable (How much time?), then do/does.
key_points.he: How many + רבים (How many people?) · How much + לא ספיר (How much time?), ואחריהם do/does.

key_points.en: a lot of in positive sentences; much and many in questions and negatives.
key_points.he: a lot of במשפטים חיוביים; much ו-many בשאלות ובשלילה.

key_points.en: a few + plural (a few minutes) · a little + uncountable (a little milk).
key_points.he: a few + רבים (a few minutes) · a little + לא ספיר (a little milk).
